description: Dialysis center finder + outcomes — Find Medicare dialysis facilities by city+state (also zip, name or ccn) with the CMS five-star rating, chain/ownership, stations, evening shift after 5pm, home dialysis options (peritoneal, home hemodialysis training) and outcome categories vs expected (survival, hospitalization, readmission, transfusion, bloodstream infection, fistula use, transplant waitlisting, ED visits) with flags; sorted best first. Optional: zip, name, ccn, home=1, late_shift=1, min_stars, limit (1-100). Source: CMS Provider Data Catalog (public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
